# Full Profile & Technical Context: Salman Mustapa, S.Kom.

## Executive Summary
Salman Mustapa, S.Kom. is an Indonesian Backend Engineer, Security Engineer, and Tech Entrepreneur. He serves as Founder & Lead Architect of PT SAMRIFA STUDIO TEKNOLOGI (PT Perorangan - Software Studio, https://samrifa.com) and specializes in building high-throughput backend services, IoT telemetry ingestion pipelines using EMQX MQTT Broker, and enforcing enterprise endpoint protection with SentinelOne XDR.

## Intellectual Property Copyright Patents (HAKI Kemenkumham RI - 50 Years Validity)
1. **HAKI 2021**: Sistem Informasi Layanan Internet Masyarakat (SILET) Dinas Komunikasi Dan Informatika Kabupaten Bone Bolango (No. Pencatatan: 000269388, 16 Agustus 2021).
2. **HAKI 2023**: Pengembangan Sistem Informasi Pengelolaan Sarana dan Prasarana Laboratorium Berbasis Android di Fakultas Teknik Universitas Negeri Gorontalo (No. Pencatatan: 000480059, 20 Juni 2023).
3. **HAKI 2026**: Calculators IMT / Antropometri Android & Web Application (No. Pencatatan: 001297659, 1 Juni 2026, Web Live: https://antropometri.samrifa.com).

## Key Technical Stack
- **Primary Languages**: JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js), PHP, Python, Java, SQL, Shell Scripting.
- **Backend Frameworks**: Express.js, Laravel Framework, RESTful API Design, WebSockets, Microservices Architecture.
- **IoT & Telemetry**: EMQX MQTT Broker Cluster Management, Mosquitto, MQTT Auth & ACL, TLS/SSL Encrypted MQTT, Telemetry Ingestion, EMQX Dashboard.
- **Cybersecurity & Systems**: SentinelOne XDR Deployment, Linux Server Hardening (Ubuntu/Debian), UFW Firewall, Threat Detection, Vulnerability Mitigation, Network Security (Mikrotik, Cisco).
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Schema Design, Time-Series Sensor Logging, Indexing & Query Optimization.
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, Linux VPS Administration, Nginx Web Server, SSL Certificates, Git Version Control.
- **Integrations**: Cross-platform API integration with Vue.js Web Dashboards, Flutter Mobile Apps, and AI Model Token/Telemetry Monitoring.
